definitions.F: (1/V) sum_sites f_e(Z, |g|^2) occ exp(2 pi i (h x + k y + l z)), V = |det A|, A rows (a,0,0), (b cos g, b sin g, 0), (c cos b, -c (cos b cos g - cos a)/sin g, V/(a b sin g)), B = inv(A)^T
definitions.reflection_order: increasing |g|; ties (within 1e-12 relative of the cluster's first) by descending (h, k, l)
definitions.families: slice 1 rule on the kept reflections: join while |g| <= g0 (1 + 1e-9); g = smallest member; orbits by the Laue group (rotation set +-R from SpacegroupAnalyzer symprec 1e-4), canonical = max by (count of non-negative indices, lexicographic); name = orbits descending joined by ' + ', Miller-Bravais only for a hexagonal-axes Laue class in a hexagonal metric; sumF2 = sum of Re^2 + Im^2 over the members (math.fsum)
definitions.cif_sites: sites AS WRITTEN (pymatgen CifParser frac_tolerance = 0, expanded, wrapped to [0, 1)); snapped sites (default CifParser) pinned beside them as sites_snapped

fe_samples.note: rows[Z-1][i] = f_e(Z, g2[i]) in Angstrom, NumPy

notes.table_row_z_plus1: relative change of |F| over the kept reflections, reading row Z instead of row Z-1
notes.fe_of_g_not_g2: relative change of |F|, f_e(|g|) instead of f_e(|g|^2)
notes.occupancy_ignored: relative change of |F| with occ = 1 for every site
notes.phase_sign_flipped_ImF: max |ImF' - ImF| / |F| over the kept reflections; |F| itself never moves (phase_sign_flipped_absF), and neither does sum |F|^2 over a ring, so the X-ray pin cannot see it. WS2 (the apps' preset and the CIF) is centrosymmetric about the cell origin (W at +-(1/3, 2/3, 1/4)): Im F = 0 there, so the flip is invisible on it; quartz and GaAs-zb see it
notes.diamond_basis_dropped: Si with the fcc sites only: relative change of |F| on the allowed reflections; the 4n+2 leak is the largest |F| it puts on reflections that must be absent
notes.cut_1e-3_kept_count: kept at 1e-4 minus kept at 1e-3 (a count)
notes.cut_ge_reflections_exactly_at_cut: number of reflections with |F| == 1e-4 exactly: 0 for every pinned structure, so '>=' for '>' is invisible on them; see cut_edge
notes.families_on_operation_allowed_list: rings of the operation-allowed reflections (slice 1) minus rings after the cut (a count)
notes.families_on_all_reflections: rings of every reflection (the lattice rings) minus rings after the cut (a count)

cut_edge.form_factor: constant 1.0 for any Z and g2 (the kit's formFactor parameter)
cut_edge.note: with this form factor every reflection has |F| == 1e-4 exactly, so '>=' for '>' keeps all of them and '>' keeps none
